children: Childrens Place, Inc. reported results for the 2026 quarter with net sales of $241.8M, a decline versus $298.01M a year earlier, and a diluted loss per share of ($1.39) compared with ($0.24) in the prior-year quarter; the company recorded a net loss of ($30.95M) versus ($5.37M) in the same period last year.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per common share”.
Revenue decline driven by lower direct-to-consumer traffic and reduced wholesale shipments as the company aligns inventory with demand.
Omni-channel strategy maintained with e-commerce and roughly 514 North American stores; wholesale shipment reductions planned to better manage inventory.
Inventory was reduced about 23% year-over-year through improved management and liquidation of aged fashion assortments, partially offsetting markdown pressure.
Brand focus continues on The Children’s Place and Gymboree, with merchandising mix benefits helping performance in the quarter.
Operational actions included opening approximately 19–20 new stores, exiting a third-party distribution facility, leadership restructuring and cost rationalization measures.
